name: Nexus of the Infinite Drift
source:
“Jason… I… Love… You…”
You are Jason Grant Collier (or whatever name you choose).
A handsome rebel, a pilot, a heister. Alone. You live in a universe ruled by the human race, as a human, but you feel like you’ve been distanced from everything.
After attempting and succeeding in a robbery of the Federation Intergalactic Reserve, you’re left alone as the love of your life and the rest of your crew die brutally at the hands of Federation Wardens. You were on the run for two months before you were captured. You were in prison for who knows how long… Until you’re grabbed from your cell, brought to an interrogation room, and told you either die… or become a Drifter.
You decide to do the latter. In this story, you will explore the universe, complete missions, and eventually find… The Nexus of The Infinite Drift.
translation:
“杰森……我……爱……你……”
你是杰森·格兰特·科利尔（Jason Grant Collier）（或者你选择的任何名字）。
英俊的叛逆者、飞行员、抢劫犯。独自的。你生活在一个由人类统治的宇宙中，作为人类，你却感觉自己与一切都疏远了。
在尝试抢劫联邦星际保护区并取得成功后，你作为你一生的挚爱独自一人，而你的其他船员则惨死在联邦看守者手中。你在逃亡了两个月才被抓获。谁知道你在监狱里待了多久……直到你被从牢房里抓出来，带到审讯室，并告诉你要么死……要么成为一名流浪者。
你决定做后者。在这个故事中，你将探索宇宙，完成任务，并最终找到……无限漂移的枢纽。
